
```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(reglin)
library(car)
library(GGally)
library(gridExtra)

tidymodels_prefer()

casas <- read.csv("casas.csv")
casas
```

```{r}
ggpairs(casas)

```
```{r}
set.seed(501)


casas_split <- initial_split(casas, prop = 0.80)
casas_train <- training(casas_split)
casas_test  <-  testing(casas_split)
dim(casas_train)
```

```{r}
lm_model <- 
  linear_reg() |> 
  set_engine("lm")

lm_wflow <- 
  workflow() |> 
  add_model(lm_model)

lm_wflow <- 
  lm_wflow |> 
  add_formula(preco ~ .)

lm_wflow
```

```{r}
lm_fit <- fit(lm_wflow, casas_train)

final_lm_res <- last_fit(lm_wflow, casas_split)

fitted_lm_wflow <- extract_workflow(final_lm_res)

fitted_lm_wflow
```

```{r}
collect_metrics(final_lm_res)
```

```{r}
fit_full <- lm(preco ~ .^2, data = casas_train)
fit <- lm(preco ~ .,data = casas_train)
lm_step <- stats::step(
  fit, 
  direction = "both", 
  scope = list(upper=fit_full)
)
```

```{r}
casas_log <- casas |>
  mutate(area = log(area))

```

```{r}
summary(lm_step)
```
